title: Turning off one scene unexpectedly turns off all active zones
description: When multiple scenes with active zones are present, disabling a single scene causes all other active zones to also turn off, even if they belong to different, still active scenes.
steps: Observe the list of scenes. Ensure that 'low intensity' and 'Medium Intensity' scenes are both active, indicated by the toggles being in the ON position.
Tap the toggle for the 'low intensity' scene to turn it OFF.
Observe that the 'Medium Intensity' scene's toggle also turns OFF.
Tap the toggle for the 'low intensity' scene to turn it ON again.
Observe that the 'Medium Intensity' scene's toggle remains OFF.
actual: When a single scene is turned off, all other active zones/scenes are also turned off simultaneously.
expected: When a single scene is turned off, only that specific scene should be turned off. Other active scenes/zones should remain in their current state.
